scope: Composition of the seven normalized simple-root Knapp-Stein operators for regular imaginary spherical D7 principal series and the resulting G-equivariant chamber-average descent.

normalized_family.adjacent_relation: the two length-three parameter-shifted products for i j i and j i j are equal
normalized_family.regular_imaginary_extension: all operators and products are unitary on L2(K/M)

d7_descent.descended_representation: one full spherical principal-series copy on L2(K/M), not a one-dimensional representation

theorem_context.reference: A.W. Knapp and E.M. Stein, normalized intertwining operator cocycle and unitarity theorem
theorem_context.application: the rank-one normalizer fixed by K1326 and the complete K1331 spectrum select the standard spherical normalization; the general cocycle then acts on the full compact picture

claim_ceiling: For the supplied regular imaginary spherical D7 principal series, normalized simple Knapp-Stein operators give exact unitary G-intertwining Coxeter transport, so the K1316 coherent diagonal is a mathematical G-subrepresentation. No charge, chamber, action, constraint or physical state is source-selected by this descent.
